title: OPAPRU, BARMM gov't laud UN chief’s comments on parliamentary polls
summary: COTABATO CITY – The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Unity and Reconciliation (OPAPRU) and the Bangsamoro government have lauded Monday’s statement of United Nations Secretary-General…

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Unity and Reconciliation (OPAPRU) and the Bangsamoro government have lauded Monday’s statement of United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, who praised the historic parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro “as a global model of a successful peace process.” In separate statements, OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen Sarmiento and Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua welcomed the comments of Guterres commending Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for the historic balloting.
